INTEGRATED SCIENCE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Acids, Bases and Indicators? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Acids, Bases and Indicators.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproductive System? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproductive System.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproductive System.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproductive System.

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory Safety.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory Safety.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory Safety.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory Safety.

9. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

10. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System.

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.

14. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

15. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

16. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Integrated Science? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Integrated Science.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Integrated Science.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Integrated Science.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Integrated Science.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Magnetism? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Magnetism.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Magnetism.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Magnetism.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetism.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn.

20. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory apparatus and instruments? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory apparatus and instruments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
22. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Magnetism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Integrated Science and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory apparatus and instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Mixtures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Acids, Bases and Indicators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Human Reproductive System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
